moved.sentence: **Permission-gated code clusters.** Files that all request or check the same permission belong together — they share an operational prerequisite and a failure mode when the permission is denied.

judged.note: should-group-permission-gated-code keeps same-permission files in one group and the clusters headline; the rationale keeps the shared operational prerequisite and permission-denied failure mode.

moved.sentence: **Entitlements define hard boundaries.** Code that requires an entitlement cannot run without it.

judged.note: should-separate-entitlement-groups keeps 'entitlements define hard boundaries' and the rationale keeps that entitlement-requiring code cannot run without it.

moved.sentence: If one candidate group requires an entitlement that others do not, they are distinct operational units.

judged.note: should-separate-entitlement-groups keeps the one-group-requires-what-others-do-not condition and treating them as distinct operational units.

moved.sentence: **OS version gates mark optional feature envelopes.** Code behind `@available(iOS 16.0, *)` is conditionally executable — flag it as a version-gated feature within its scope group.

judged.note: should-flag-version-gated-features keeps flagging @available-gated code as a version-gated feature within its group and the envelope headline; the rationale keeps the conditionally-executable reason.

moved.sentence: If it constitutes a large portion of the group, it may warrant its own scope group.

judged.note: may-give-large-version-gated-code-own-group keeps the large-portion condition and MAY warrant its own scope group.

moved.sentence: **Environment-specific code belongs in a configuration scope group.** Code that reads environment variables, loads config files, or applies build-time conditionals is configuration infrastructure — it typically belongs in one scope group rather than scattered.

judged.note: should-group-environment-specific-code keeps the three kinds of environment-specific code and 'typically one configuration group rather than scattered'; the rationale keeps that it is configuration infrastructure.

moved.sentence: **Feature-flagged code is pre-production.** Large blocks of feature-flagged code indicate in-flight work.

judged.note: should-not-group-unenabled-code-paths keeps the pre-production headline and the rationale keeps that large feature-flagged blocks indicate in-flight work.

moved.sentence: Document the flags but do not create scope groups around unenabled code paths.

judged.note: should-document-feature-flags keeps documenting the flags and should-not-group-unenabled-code-paths keeps the prohibition on groups around unenabled paths.

moved.sentence: **Remote config dependencies imply a network prerequisite.** Code that requires a remote config fetch before it can function has an implicit startup dependency — note this as an operational ordering constraint.

judged.note: should-note-remote-config-ordering keeps noting the operational ordering constraint and the network-prerequisite headline; the rationale keeps the implicit startup dependency.
